title: Linh's Tropical Snow Tết
segments: Linh arrived on sunny Côn Đảo Island for Tết. The air was warm, and palm trees swayed gently. She thought of her grandmother, who lived far away in a cold place. "Grandma loves snow," Linh whispered. "I wish I could send her a snowy Tết picture from here, but it's so tropical!" She felt a little sad.

Because of this, Linh looked at the bright, tropical flowers and then at the white sand. Suddenly, an idea sparked! "Maybe I can make my own snow!" she thought. She wouldn't send a real snowy picture, but a creative one. Linh imagined her grandmother's happy smile when she saw the special Tết photo.

Then, Linh rushed to find materials for her project. She remembered the white sand and thought about things that looked like snow. She tried tearing up white paper into tiny pieces. It looked a little flat. Next, she found some soft cotton balls. She pulled them apart, making fluffy bits. This looked much better!

Then, Linh worked hard, pulling more cotton balls apart. Fluffy white piles grew on the table. Her mother and father walked in, surprised. "What are you doing, Linh?" her mother asked gently. Linh explained her plan for a snowy Tết photo for Grandma. Her parents smiled, touched by her creativity. They decided to help make her dream come true.

Because of this, Linh’s parents quickly helped. Her dad found a blue blanket for the background. Her mom carefully arranged the fluffy cotton 'snow' on a small table. Linh put on her pretty Tết dress. She held a small, red lantern. Then, her dad took many pictures. The photos looked like real snow!

After that, Linh quickly chose the best picture. It showed her smiling, holding the red lantern against the blue blanket 'snow.' She sent it to her grandmother. Soon, Grandma called, her voice full of joy. "Oh, Linh! It's beautiful! Snowy Tết in Côn Đảo!" Linh felt warm and happy. Her creative surprise was a success!
endWrap: Linh's clever idea made her grandmother's Tết special. She learned that love and creativity can make any dream come true, even on a tropical island.
